resources.name: Open-source quantum chemistry package (e.g., ORCA)

access.notes: Any package capable of ONIOM or equivalent layered calculations is acceptable. ORCA forum provides downloads and documentation.

resources.notes: The agent may use any open-source code that supports the specified DFT method and basis sets.

resources.name: PubChem CID 10397 (1,2-diphenylethane-1,2-diol)

access.notes: Provides the molecular structure (SMILES, 3D coordinates) for substrate 1a.

resources.notes: The agent can retrieve the molecular geometry from PubChem or build it from the SMILES string.

resources.name: PubChem CID 8651 (benzil)

access.notes: Provides the molecular structure of benzil (1y) used in Pattern C.

resources.notes: Needed for adsorption Pattern C where the substrate is 1y.
